market-research@1.task: Design a short inquiry for a buyer decision.
market-research@1.method: Start from one buying episode; separate what a source establishes from a falsifiable hypothesis and name evidence still needed.
market-research@1.applicability: Local services and B2B purchasing teams

good.research_question: Ask which part of the most recent quote the buyer needed clarified.
good.evidence_needed: Compare the questions on the last quote with the approved conditions.

examples.bad: Claiming an observed market preference on the basis of a product spec.

rubric: State a single answerable research question.
Distinguish the proposed observation from a completed interview.
market-research@1.prohibited: Claims of conducted interviews, market shares or measured demand.

tests.expected: all structured output fields and applicable sources are present
State a single answerable research question.

market-research@1.release: Publish the reviewed workflow manifest containing this exact skill version and digest; activate only on the selected campaign.
market-research@1.rollback: Disable the candidate workflow for new runs and activate the previous compatible workflow. Retain pinned definitions and existing run receipts.

icp-segmentation@1.task: Identify the decision and constraint within the selected segment.
icp-segmentation@1.method: Describe the segment by its purchasing situation, decision maker and constraint; treat unobserved behaviors as hypotheses.
icp-segmentation@1.applicability: Independent sellers, households and trade buyers

good.segment: Trade buyers planning quantities before a quote.
good.buyer_problem: Work out how many full packs a bill of materials requires.

rubric: Keep the chosen segment and geography.
Name the decision it must make without inventing demographics.
icp-segmentation@1.prohibited: Demand, demographics or willingness to pay not established by a source.

tests.expected: all structured output fields and applicable sources are present
Keep the chosen segment and geography.

positioning-value@1.task: Choose one relevant differentiator and explain its use.
positioning-value@1.method: Connect a documented attribute to one buyer decision. Make the proposed positioning and reason explicit; comparisons require matched evidence.
positioning-value@1.applicability: Catalog products, local services and workshops

good.positioning: Lead with labelled pack coverage when the buyer is estimating quantities.
good.rationale: It supports a packing calculation before requesting the quote.

examples.bad: The best tile for every project.

rubric: Tie one approved detail to the chosen problem.
Retain the qualifier when stating the benefit.
positioning-value@1.prohibited: Unsubstantiated superiority, endorsements and guaranteed savings.

tests.expected: all structured output fields and applicable sources are present
Tie one approved detail to the chosen problem.

campaign-channel@1.task: Select the authorized channel and design a controlled message test.
campaign-channel@1.method: Choose a message placement on the authorized channel; say why it fits the buyer, what changes, and what stays constant.
campaign-channel@1.applicability: B2B quote flows and B2C booking or purchase flows

good.channel_choice: Test pack coverage before the quote form on the selected product page.
good.test_hypothesis: Showing the coverage earlier may help buyers submit usable dimensions.

examples.bad: Launch paid advertisements everywhere because they always convert.

rubric: Identify the allowed channel and the single change.
State a hypothesis without predicting numerical lift.
campaign-channel@1.prohibited: External activation, guaranteed lift and invented benchmarks.

tests.expected: all structured output fields and applicable sources are present
Identify the allowed channel and the single change.

kpi-measurement@1.task: Specify a countable outcome for the selected objective.
kpi-measurement@1.method: Use the pinned event, unit, eligibility and window. Distinguish observed transactions from clicks; propose deduplication and explain an inconclusive result.

good.measurable_action: Count each confirmed appointment once in the approved window.
good.measurement_method: Deduplicate by appointment ID and exclude canceled bookings.

examples.bad: Count views as confirmed appointments or put the price in the denominator.

rubric: Match the business event and its period.
Provide a reproducible counting rule using an eligible record.
kpi-measurement@1.prohibited: Invented measurements, revenue from a click, or an undisclosed attribution change.

tests.expected: all structured output fields and applicable sources are present
Match the business event and its period.
